description: California State University (CSU) admissions data by campus and systemwide trends. Campus-level data includes applicants, admits, enrollees, acceptance rates, yield rates, and test score ranges for all 23 CSU campuses. Systemwide trend data spans 2021-2025 with breakdowns by student type (first-time freshmen vs. undergraduate transfers). Fall 2024 total enrollment by campus also included.

years_covered.campus_admissions: 2023-24 admissions cycle (most recent available via CollegeBoard BigFuture, based on IPEDS data)
years_covered.enrollment: Fall 2024 (from CSU Facts About the CSU)

data_notes.campus_admissions: First-time freshman applicants data from CollegeBoard BigFuture profiles. These are primarily based on college-reported data through the IPEDS/CDS pipeline. Acceptance rates are for first-time freshmen only and differ from overall system rates which include transfers.
data_notes.systemwide_trends: Total unduplicated undergraduate applications, admissions, and enrollment from CSU's institutional research Tableau dashboards. Includes both freshmen and transfer applicants.
data_notes.enrollment: Total headcount enrollment (undergraduate + graduate) for Fall 2024 from CSU official statistics.
data_notes.discrepancy_note: Campus-level applicant/admit totals from BigFuture (674,936 applicants) are lower than CSU systemwide totals (~378K in 2025) because BigFuture counts are unduplicated per-campus first-time freshman only, while CSU systemwide figures include transfers and a student applying to multiple campuses appears once in systemwide but multiple times across campus totals.

file_manifest.csu-admissions-data.json: Comprehensive JSON with all admissions data (campus-level, systemwide trends, enrollment)
file_manifest.csu-admissions-by-campus.csv: Campus-level admissions: applicants, admits, enrolled, acceptance rate, yield rate, SAT/ACT ranges (sorted by selectivity)
file_manifest.csu-admissions-by-student-type.csv: Systemwide admissions broken down by first-time freshmen vs. undergraduate transfers, 2021-2025
file_manifest.csu-fall2024-enrollment-by-campus.csv: Total enrollment by campus for Fall 2024
file_manifest.metadata.json: This file — data provenance, sources, and manifest

key_findings.most_selective: Cal Poly San Luis Obispo (29.65% acceptance rate)
